name: Software Development Agreement
description: An agreement under which a developer builds custom software, a website or an app for a client. The checks read for written specifications, an acceptance procedure, a payment schedule tied to the work, an assignment of the software rather than only a work-for-hire statement, the developer's pre-existing materials, and open-source components. Distinct from `msa-general`, which reads a general services agreement, and from `work-for-hire-agreement`, which reads a commissioned creative work.
compliance_matrix_columns: Specifications the software is built to
Acceptance testing, and what happens if the client says nothing
Payment schedule tied to the work
An assignment of the software, not only a work-for-hire statement
